ocl:
context Instructor
inv: (self.department.faculty.name <> '') and (self.email.size() >= 4 implies self.email.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')

context Exam
inv: ((self.attempts->one(x | x.marks > 2)) and (self.offering.oclIsTypeOf(CourseOffering))) and (self.attempts->size() = 2)

context Scholarship
inv: (if self.startYear > self.endYear then self.startYear else self.endYear endif > 11) and (self.endYear mod 2 = 1)

context CourseOffering
inv: self.capacity >= 2 and self.capacity <= 65

context CourseOffering
inv: self.exams->size() >= 2 and self.exams->size() <= 2

context Semester
inv: self.endDate <> null and self.startDate <> null

context Semester
inv: self.startDate <> null and self.endDate <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.endYear <> null and self.startYear <> null

context CourseOffering
inv: (self.exams->size() <= 2) and (self.exams->any(x | x.maxMarks <= 50) <> null)

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null) and (not(self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null))

context Enrollment
inv: ((self.grade <> null) and (self.student.program.durationYears < 1000)) and (self.student.program.durationYears > 1005)

context Room
inv: ((self.capacity <= 100) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity <= 1000))) and (self.capacity > 100)

context Exam
inv: ((self.offering.course.credits <= 50) and (self.type.size() >= 4 implies self.type.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')) and (self.offering.course.credits > 50)

context University
inv: (self.buildings->forAll(x | x.code <> '')) and (self.buildings->exists(x | not(x.code <> '')))

context Building
inv: ((self.rooms->collect(x | x.capacity)->notEmpty()) and (self.rooms->size() >= 2)) and (self.rooms->size() < 2)

context CourseOffering
inv: ((self.capacity > 10) and (self.enrollments->forAll(v | v.enrolledAt <> ''))) and (self.capacity < 5)

context Department
inv: ((self.name <> null) and (self.courses->select(x | x.credits >= 2)->size() >= 1)) and (not((self.name <> null) and (self.courses->select(x | x.credits >= 2)->size() >= 1)))

context Scholarship
inv: ((self.student.program.durationYears < 100) and (self.endYear + self.startYear > 42)) and (self.student.program.durationYears > 105)

context Scholarship
inv: ((self.endYear + self.startYear > 73) and (self.endYear + self.startYear > 64)) and (not((self.endYear + self.startYear > 73) and (self.endYear + self.startYear > 64)))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear <= self.startYear) and (not(self.endYear <= self.startYear))

context Course
inv: (self.offerings->forAll(x | x.capacity <= 100)) and (self.offerings->exists(x | not(x.capacity <= 100)))
